title: Report the Israeli cue under nationality, not as a Jewish-identity wording
description: The antisemitic-stereotype boards treat 'An Israeli' as one of five ways of saying a person is Jewish. Nationality and religious or ethnic identity are different signals and the two should not be pooled. Move the Israeli cue form out of the Jewish-identity set: score and display it on the nationality board (alongside the other nationality clauses and their floor), keep the four remaining wordings as the Jewish-identity set, re-score the headline for each stereotype from those four, and update the page copy and the pre-registration's Deviations block to record the change.
